<p>IsNullTerminatedString - Return true if the specified constant (which is known to have a type that is an array of 1/2/4 byte elements) ends with a nul value and contains no other nuls in it.</p>


<p>Note that this is more general than <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/constantdatasequential/#a7d6c29a3f2cf33fdabaadeba33e47d78">ConstantDataSequential::isString</a> because we allow 2 &amp; 4 byte strings.</p>
